name: Cadence
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished, designer-quality brand direction presentation board for a new product called "prosody" (spell exactly p r o s o d y). This is a private agent-to-human listening/viewing inbox: AI agents send text, images, audio and video; text becomes concise spoken briefings, and humans swipe vertically through individual items. Brand must span listening AND seeing, feel elegantly minimalist and human, not look like a chatbot or a music streaming clone.
Asset: a wide landscape high-resolution brand concept board. Flat front-on graphic design, crisp typography, immaculate generous spacing, exact grid, no photographic scene or desk mockup, no 3D extrusions, no shiny glass, no fake gradients, no decorative stock imagery. A real bespoke logo symbol, not clipart; iconic at 24px and credible in one ink. The brand direction title is small upper left. The principal logo/wordmark is very large on the left, with an enlarged standalone mark, a small iOS rounded-square icon study, and a monochrome mark application. Bottom left: four color swatches labeled with their hex values and a small typography specimen. Right half: two straight-on miniature mobile screen previews side by side, one light and one dark, enough detail to judge brand, with flat phone boundaries, no perspective.
Both previews show SAME content: top "Personal" with a small downward chevron; secondary label "Research agent"; large title "A small change. A useful result."; small body "Processing is faster. Another run will test whether it holds."; a fine progress line, a large simple circular play button, small "Swipe for next" bottom. Show NO bottom tab bar, no social reactions, no hearts/comments/shares, no reply input, no decorative waveform or filler data. Do not draw a real operating-system status bar; these are brand application studies, not full UX specifications. All body text must be legible. Keep the generated screens genuinely minimal.
Small footer "PROSODY / BRAND EXPLORATION / 01" (change final number to direction number). Label previews "LIGHT" and "DARK". The brand is always prosody, direction names are concept titles not product renamings. Do not add extra slogans or promotional claims.
DIRECTION 01 — CADENCE. Exact heading: "01 / CADENCE". A warm editorial identity, like a beautifully typeset private journal that can speak. Palette: warm paper #F4F0E8, deep ink #242820, restrained burnt vermilion #B84D35, muted sage #858D78. Dominant board background is paper. Mark concept: a custom lowercase p made from one confident vertical stem and an open circular bowl whose tiny deliberate gap reads like a breath in a sentence; strong distinctive proportions, softly eased terminals, NOT a speech bubble, NOT headphones, NOT a standard font glyph. Pair this mark with an elegant lowercase contemporary serif wordmark, medium contrast, no fragile hairlines. Title typography: editorial serif with generous line height; UI metadata/body in a quiet humanist sans. Dark preview uses ink surface and warm paper text, vermilion only for key controls; preserve readable contrast. App icon is ink mark on paper, optionally vermilion on paper. Identity should feel literate, intimate, collected, enduring. Avoid retro newspaper ornament. Signature is the breath gap in the p bowl, repeated subtly in the progress control. Aim for a distinctive premium identity, not a template.
